dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast pale grey edges on the folded secondary and tertial feathers create a sharp boundary against the darker grey feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, high-contrast white patch with an oval geometric footprint is visible on the lateral side of the nape.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail displays prominent transverse banding, including a broad, dark terminal band and a lighter subterminal region.
